newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER, VOLUME FALL.
newsitem.headline: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER, VOLUME FALL.

text.p: Turnover fell to 51,410 denars at Thursday's session of the Macedonian Stock Exchange from 200,790 denars on Tuesday as only one company traded, the exchange said.
Alkaloid joint stock company sold 53 shares at 970 denars, unchanged from Tuesday's close and below par of 2,424 denars.
Traded volume was 207 stocks at the previous session when only Alkaloid shares traded.
Listed companies trade in two floor sessions. The exchange trades on Tuesday and Thursday.
